title: Conference identity suite
slide_intent: Show a coordinated event family because a brand must work across objects with different sizes and uses.
strategic_value: Repeated circles, restrained tones and consistent naming can connect physical and digital event materials.
demonstration: A dark flat lay groups a bag, phone, badge, envelope and spiral booklet with circular graphics.
practical_value: Compare the same visual vocabulary across an event suite.

content_islands.name: Suite
content_islands.spec: Arrange the five event objects on the dark ground with the bag at left and phone and badge above.

content_islands.name: Graphic treatment
content_islands.spec: Preserve the dark circles, outlined arcs, white conference text and small colored signatures.

reference_purposes.Application: The artwork applies one conference identity to a bag, smartphone, badge, envelope and booklet.
